findings.what: GetRandomNumber is declared long although its accepted definition returns unsigned short. The comment and author rationale imply a full-width caller declaration is needed for matching, but changing only this declaration to extern unsigned short GetRandomNumber(); still matches all 21 functions in REV 02 and REV 00. This is an avoidable cross-unit type mismatch, not a necessary qualification.
findings.suggested_fix: Use extern unsigned short GetRandomNumber(); and remove or correct the surrounding declaration-width rationale. The private random_short.c experiment is the isolated byte-identical correction in both revisions.
